name: poppy-film
prompt: One continuous cinematic macro shot. The giant scarlet poppy in the foreground moves very gently in a passing breeze, its thin translucent petals flutter with physically realistic subtle motion. Distant meadow grasses sway softly. Camera makes a very slow controlled 8 percent push toward the flower. Preserve composition, blue dusk sky, red petal texture, photoreal analog film style. No new objects, no people, no text, no cuts. Intimate and almost still.

name: petal-transition
prompt: A single seamless cinematic dream transition between the two reference frames. Begin on the huge red poppy in the meadow at dusk. Camera pushes INTO a translucent red petal until red silk-like petal texture fills the entire screen. Travel through soft scarlet darkness. Then pull back from a small red poppy in a glass vase to reveal the intimate rainy cafe table with two used coffee cups shown in the final frame. The red flower is the connection between worlds. Smooth slow film camera, credible materials, no people, no text, no flash, no abrupt dissolve. Final two seconds hold gently on the rainy cafe while drops slide on the glass.
